value.summary: The change refactors the host loop from processing one authorized turn per iteration to processing a round of turns, committing the round's state once after all turns are durably appended. The per-turn failure path, aside handling, referral consideration, and budget accounting are all preserved correctly under the new round model, and the pinboard read is properly bounded at `round_start` to prevent leaking concurrent round-mates' pins. The change looks safe to merge.
